faq.q: How do I make a product photo background white?
faq.a: Upload one clear product photo, choose the white background, and download the listing image. You do not book a studio or cut the product out by hand.

faq.q: Does Amazon require a white background for product photos?
faq.a: Category rules can require a plain main image. Check the current rule for your category, then publish. A white file is not a promise that the listing will pass review.

faq.q: Will the product look flat on white?
faq.a: A soft shadow where the item meets the white keeps it from looking like a sticker. Even light in your photo helps the color and texture stay easy to see.

faq.q: Can I post the image on Amazon, Shopify, or Etsy?
faq.a: Yes, after you check that store's current image rule. The download has no watermark, and you can use it in your shop and ads. Read the [Amazon white background photo](page:guide-white-background-amazon) guide before you set a main image.

faq.q: How many credits does one photo use?
faq.a: One product photo uses 24 credits. A credit is one unit your plan spends on a job. The cost appears before you start, and if the photo fails those credits come back.

faq.q: Can I run this across my whole catalog at once?
faq.a: Yes. Put the same white background on a set of photos at once, in the app or from your own software (the API). Each photo is 24 credits, shown before it starts.

faq.q: Can my own software ask for a white background?
faq.a: Yes. Send the product photo and ask for the white background. That request is the API. The cost is 24 credits per photo, and it shows before the photo starts.

faq.q: Is there a free white background photo?
faq.a: There is no free plan. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600. The same credits also pay for videos.

faq.q: What should my starting photo show?
faq.a: The whole product, with edges that are not cut off. A simple background in the original photo makes the white result easier to check.

definition.title: What a White Background Product Photo Is
paras: A white background product photo keeps the item easy to scan in a grid of listings. Color, outline, and small details stay visible because the area behind the product is plain.

It is a listing image, not a lifestyle scene. The same plain file can go to your store, across many photos at once, or through your own software (the API). Check the photo rules for your product category before you publish a main image.
